work.abstract_text: Extending Glaisher's (1900) congruence to exact literal-remainder counts, we determine OEIS A222759 and prove Noe's growth assertion in its first comment (12 March 2013; revision 12, 2 November 2024). For every positive integer n, its conjectured count equals pi(floor(n^(1/3))) plus two explicit corrections supported below 27. Consequently, for every k >= 3, the count is at least k exactly when n >= p_k^3, sharpening the stated sufficient threshold p_(p_k^3). The same description determines A222760, including its exceptional relation to A222759 at n=5. We give a self-contained proof, the counts modulo p and p^2, and elementary consequences for the linked prime-counting entries.

work.title: Exact counts and sharp growth for OEIS A222759, first comment (12 March 2013): extending Glaisher (1900)
